deity.en: The Devi as Sunanda, worshipped locally as Ugratara

history.en: The Sugandha Shakti Peetha is a temple of the goddess Sunanda in the village of Shikarpur, about 16 km (10 miles) north of Barishal in Bangladesh. Banglapedia's table of the pithas lists Sugandha at Shikarpur with the nose as the fallen part.

story.en: According to the Puranas, Sati, the daughter of Daksha, gave up her life in the fire of her father's sacrifice after he insulted her husband Shiva. Grieving, Shiva carried her body across the world until Vishnu's discus divided it, and each place where a part fell became a Shakti Peetha. Tradition holds that Sati's nose fell here.

en: The goddess is worshipped here as Ugratara.
Sugandha is one of the Pithanirnaya's pithas in present-day Bangladesh.
The Bhairava of the pitha is Tryambaka.

timings.en: No official timings are published; check locally before visiting.

nearestRail.en: There is no railway to Barishal; it is reached by road or by river from Dhaka.
